correctness.rationale: Exact border classification yields C_U and C_V and the weighted survival denominators. A scalar V-root t(p) in (q,1) has strictly positive t derivative and strictly positive p derivative in its defining equation; thus t decreases in p and the unique possible crossover factor H_k increases 0 to infinity. Opposite strict endpoint root orderings and Perron-continuity force the unique actual crossover. Elimination gives a unique t_k polynomial zero with monotone derivative; a regular implicit expansion at 1/k=0 gives both asymptotic terms. Exact independent prefix-automaton vs rational generating-function comparison passes 1848 cases and 630 structural checks. Computation does not replace the universal proof.

originality.rationale: The k=2 equal-measure crossover is prior art (Bonanno–Cristadoro–Lenci, 2022, Remark 3.7), and the general correlation formula is fully credited. The proposed new k>=3 contribution is an all-parameter unique crossing classification with an exact scalar polynomial and a two-term logarithmic threshold asymptotic. Comparisons with three directly inspected scholarly texts and multiple published-record searches did not identify a stronger covering result; historical priority remains provisional.

value.rationale: The two holes have identical measure for every Bernoulli bias but their escape ordering reverses exactly once for every k>=3. This all-k sharp phase result identifies a nonlinear border-overlap competition and a universal log(2)/k threshold with new explicit second-order coefficient. It is not merely the prior k=2 example, and supplies a potentially reusable parameter scale for equal-measure open symbolic systems.
